label: A favouring determination that makes a verdict value does not back is not pure
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every favouring profile phi, if phi makes a verdict that the betterness standard read as value does not back (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1: for some scenario and candidates x, y, phi favours x over y there and x is not a better good than y there), then the real determination that a favouring of the bearer is phi is not a pure perfection (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION). It is the arbitrariness half of 'restriction of favouring content is limitation' in its value-relative form: a standing preference against value, or among value-tied candidates, is not a pure perfection. It concerns only the verdicts of favouring profiles, the favouring as a function of the scenario; it says nothing about a selection that is not such a verdict, nor about whether that selection is a real determination of the bearer.
